title: Balance and probability of a positive value
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its real-valued form has mean zero if and only if, under the uniform distribution on the cube, the probability that $f$ equals $+1$ is $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
